description: V2 regulatory evidence for CR2032. Context-separated records. Hazard facts are not legal obligations. Product-containing obligations never applied to loose cells. Only includes sources in the V2 source register.

loose_battery.description: Regulatory facts applying to CR2032 as a loose, unpackaged coin cell. Does not apply product-containing device obligations.

fields.sourceFact: Button batteries can be hazardous if swallowed. Regulator has published consumer safety information.
fields.note: Hazard fact only. Not a legal obligation. Do not reproduce source text without rights clearance.

fields.sourceFact: ACCC overview describes button and coin batteries as a category with specific safety concerns.
fields.note: Overview is not the legislative instrument. Do not treat as legal obligation.

product_containing.description: Regulatory facts applying to products that contain CR2032. These obligations apply to device manufacturers, not to loose cells. NEVER apply these to the loose battery context.

fields.sourceFact: ACCC overview references requirements for products containing button batteries including secure battery compartments.
fields.note: Must never be applied to loose_battery context. Device-manufacturer obligation only.

consumer_handling.description: Consumer safety handling guidance. Based only on regulator overview facts. Does not constitute legal advice.

fields.sourceFact: ACCC overview includes consumer safety guidance for button batteries.
fields.note: Consumer guidance only. Not legal advice. Withheld until source rights are cleared.

supplier_compliance.description: Supplier/business compliance context. Penalties and recall obligations belong here only. Not for consumer-facing output.

fields.sourceFact: ACCC overview references supplier responsibilities for products containing button batteries.
fields.note: Penalties and recall information belongs in this context only. Not for public consumer output. Do not reproduce regulator text.
